faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Anna University for a project-based position under the Chief Minister's Research Grant.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The post announced in this notification is Project Assistant under advertisement number CMRG / 3005 / H3 / 2024 / 047.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Assistant position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 16 October 2026 by 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted in offline mode by post along with a scanned copy sent via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What educational qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess B.E/B.Tech or M.E/M.Tech/MS in relevant engineering and science fields such as CSE, IT, ECE, EEE, and AI.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent to Dr. S. Chitrakala, Professor & Principal Investigator, Department of CSE, College of Engineering, Guindy, Anna University, Chennai - 600025.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official recruitment notification for this post.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process involves short-listing of candidates followed by a written test and/or an interview.
